Name: GodPristines Tool Retextures
Author: GodPristine
Description:
Essentially this mod just retextures the main tools, and some misc tools, and makes them have the shape of the iridium tools. This mod currently conflicts with every mod that retextures vanilla tools. This will be changed in the future!



12/01/2024 - Retextured everything!

Downloads.Description: Current version! This replaces ALL tool sets with the iridium tool shape, but my custom recolor! It also recolors some misc tools.
